correctness.rationale: For n≥2, SPD A and all symmetric Frobenius-unit-ball E, whitening gives B=I+t A^-1/2 E A^-1/2. The condition-number cap K>1 is exactly all orthonormal-pair quadratic inequalities. Frobenius duality reduces to sqrt(K²a²+d²-2Kb²) for the compression of H=A^-1; its plane-angle quadratic is convex, so extrema align with the top two compression eigenvectors; Poincaré/min-max bounds them by 1/λ1 and 1/λ2. Thus t*=(K-1)/sqrt(K²/λ1²+1/λ2²). Since t*<λ1, all endpoint matrices are SPD. Rank-two commuting E*=(-K h1 w1w1^T +h2 w2w2^T)/L has norm one and saturates K; scaled adversary disproves robustness at every t>t*. Independently checked exact A=diag(1,2),K=2 B eigenvalues 9/17,18/17 and 100 4x4 random perturbations. Repeated minimal eigenvalues covered via orthonormal basis.
